title: Ploeg authenticated operator API v1
description: GET /api/v1/operator/{teams,summary,unsettled-accounts,work-items,work-items/{id},runs,runs/{id},runs/{id}/transcript,events,route-refusals}, and POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/cancel, which requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor and withdraws tracker-originated work; repeating it on a withdrawn or settled item changes nothing and reports withdrawn false. Cancel takes no body or a cancelRequest: a commandId that already withdrew the item answers replayed true, and an expectedShiftId that is not the item's open Shift answers 409 shift_changed and withdraws nothing. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/approve and /reject decide a proposed Work Item a Run created (ADR-0031); both require execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor and take a JSON body {"reason": string}, required for reject. Approve queues the item; reject closes it as done and releases its allotted budget. Any other state answers 409 not_proposed. Bearer consumers have team scope. Collection after is a decimal bigint cursor; limit defaults 50, maximum 200. Work items filter on team, state, needsHuman=true and the tracker identity provider plus externalId, which must be given together and match across every team in scope unless team narrows it. state takes one state or a comma-separated list of distinct states and keeps items in any of them; the retired leased is read as active until the deprecated forms are removed (ADR-0093). Work items take order=asc|desc (default asc) like events: order=desc returns newest first by id and pages with before=<nextCursor>; after with order=desc, or before without it, is rejected. Detail returns the most recent 200 records per collection, with explicit truncation flags. Audit pagination has snapshot consistency and is not a lossless changefeed: IDs are allocated before commit. Unbound events are omitted. Missing costs and unsupported team pause state remain unknown/null. Text is bounded (16384 characters for descriptions/findings, 4096 for summaries/reasons/URLs), recognizable credentials are redacted, URL queries/fragments are removed. Other credential-bearing structural fields are never selected. A recorded cost is an observation, not proof of final gateway settlement. Summary takes window=24h|7d|30d (default 7d): Work Item counts, pending and running Runs and heldUsd (the Hold, ADR-0093) are current; finished, failed and stuck count Runs finished inside the window by outcome, and settledUsd is spend settled inside the window; lastActivityAt is the Team's latest bound audit event. The Run list is newest first by id with limit 1..200 (default 50), filters team, state and outcome, and pages with before=<runId>, returning nextBefore; teams are scoped by the owning Work Item and externalRef is the tracker reference used in trailers, or empty for manual work. Events take order=asc|desc (default asc); order=desc returns newest first, pages with before=<eventId> and returns that cursor as nextCursor, and lastCursor is the newest event id in the page (0 when empty); after with order=desc, or before without it, is rejected. Timestamps in summary and Run list responses are UTC. Unsettled-accounts takes no query parameters and lists, oldest first and at most 200, the finished Runs in scope whose gateway key the block sweep cannot block (account minting, issued or unknown) and those whose key is blocked but whose account is still unsettled an hour after the Run finished (account blocked), each with the budget it still holds; totals cover every such Run in scope, also past the 200th. Route refusals (ADR-0038) lists tracker tasks that routing refused and that therefore have no Work Item: it takes no query parameters and answers the newest refusal of each task refused in the last windowDays (14) days, newest first and at most 50, within the consumer's team scope. A task queued or refreshed after its newest refusal is left out. code is stable; a refusal recorded before codes existed answers unclassified with allowedLabels empty, and reason is the sentence Ploeg also commented on the task. allowedLabels are the repo/ labels the matched board rule allows, empty when no rule matched or the reason is target_not_ready. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/requeue restarts a needs_human, stale or awaiting_review Work Item with no open Shift (ADR-0044); it requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor. Without a body it restarts from Round 1; a body is a requeueRequest and must carry commandId, and a repeated commandId returns the first result with replayed true. A live, settled, withdrawn or operator-owned item, an expectedState mismatch and a commandId reused with another body answer 409; a fromRound outside the Team's current plan answers 422 round_not_in_plan, and a fromRound past a writing Round when no earlier Shift recorded pr_opened or pr_updated answers 422 nothing_to_review; a pool above the consumer's maxBudgetUsd answers 400 pool_above_limit. Delivery facts (ADR-0079): GET /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/facts answers factsResponse, and 404 when the Work Item is not in the consumer's scope. GET /api/v1/operator/facts answers factsListResponse: the consumer's team-scoped Work Items, newest activityAt first, ties by id. It takes member=<login>, repeatable up to 20 and compared without case, to keep Work Items whose roster names one of them, team, since=<RFC 3339> to keep activityAt at or after it, before=<nextBefore> and limit 1..25 (default 10); nextBefore is an opaque cursor or null. Facts are stored values only: no grade, tier, score, KPI, status kind or working time. PUT /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/pull-request-comments/{key} takes a pullRequestCommentRequest and keeps one comment per pull request and key, marked <!-- ploeg:comment:<key> -->, posted with Ploeg's forge credentials; it requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor, answers pullRequestCommentResponse, 404 for a Work Item outside the scope or a pull request it does not have, 409 no_pull_request when it has none, 422 unsafe_svg, 422 adopt_not_found when adoptCommentId names no Ploeg-marked comment, 413 for a body over 384 KiB and 502 forge_unavailable when the forge refused; each write is audited as pull_request_comment.upserted. DELETE on the same path removes that key's comment from every pull request where Ploeg recorded it, audited as pull_request_comment.deleted, and answers pullRequestCommentDeleteResponse. The Run card, card list, crack, evolved and card legacy export routes were removed by ADR-0080 and answer 404. GET /api/v1/operator/allowances?team=<team> answers allowanceResponse: the team's Ask Allowance for the current UTC month (ADR-0082), 400 without exactly one team and 403 for a team outside the consumer's scope. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/asks admits an Ask on a Work Item in the consumer's scope (ADR-0082): it requires execute permission and exactly one X-Ploeg-Actor, takes an askAdmitRequest and answers askAdmitResponse, 201 when new and 200 for a replayed askId, which never mints a second key. It answers 404 for a Work Item outside the scope, 400 invalid_ask, 409 ask_conflict when the askId was used for another Work Item, question or actor, 402 allowanceRefusalResponse when the team's allowance cannot cover the per-Ask Budget, 409 inference_policy when the team has no (team, ask) inference policy, 409 credential_unresolved when the mint is unresolved and 503 inference_unavailable without managed inference. GET /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/asks/{askId} answers askResponse, and POST .../asks/{askId}/finish finishes the Ask, blocks its key and answers askFinishResponse, or 503 block_unconfirmed while a retried block is pending; both are scoped to the consumer and actor that admitted the Ask. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/notes stores an operator instruction for a live Work Item in the consumer's scope: it requires execute permission and exactly one X-Ploeg-Actor, takes a noteRequest and answers noteResponse, 201 when new and 200 for a replayed commandId. It answers 404 for a Work Item outside the scope, 400 command_required or invalid_note, 409 operator_owned for an item bound to an Operator Execution, 409 work_item_terminal for a done, needs_human, awaiting_review, stale or withdrawn item, 409 shift_changed when expectedShiftId is not the open Shift and 409 command_conflict for a commandId reused with another body. Each note is audited as operator.note.added. The next claimed Run of the Work Item, other than an Ask, is briefed with every unconsumed note as an "operator note" finding, and each is then marked consumed and audited as operator.note.consumed, so a note reaches one Run. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items admits a manual-origin Work Item that ploeg-worker executes (ADR-0102): it requires execute permission and exactly one X-Ploeg-Actor, takes a workItemAdmissionRequest and answers workItemAdmissionResponse, 201 when new and 200 for a replayed requestId. The Work Item is queued for its Team, not operator-owned, pinned to the registered target and allotted budgetUsd or, without it, the consumer's maxBudgetUsd, which caps its Shift pool. A replay with the same actor and body returns the Work Item in its current state and never queues it again; a requestId reused with another body or actor, or one that names an Operator Execution, answers 409 request_conflict. It answers 400 invalid_admission, 400 budget_above_limit for a budgetUsd above maxBudgetUsd, 403 team_forbidden for a team outside the scope, 422 unknown_target, 422 target_not_ready, 422 team_not_dispatched for a team without a plan while uniform dispatch is off, 422 harness_not_allowed for a harness no Role of the plan allows (the message names each Role's allowlist), 422 harness_unqualified for an allowed but unqualified harness that is no Role's default while the Team has not set allowUnqualifiedHarnesses, 422 model_not_allowed for a model no Role's policy lists (the message names each Role's models), 422 model_requires_managed_inference for a model when the Team's Roles have no managed inference policy, and 503 dispatch_unavailable without Shift dispatch; each refusal records nothing. The response lists, per Role, the Harness and model its Runs store (ADR-0098, ADR-0103). Each Admission is audited once as operator.work_item.admitted with detail.requestId; a replay is not. Cancel, requeue and notes apply to the admitted Work Item as to tracker work, and its cancel calls no tracker. Attribution (ADR-0108): every operator request other than GET may carry, each at most once, X-Ploeg-Actor (the person, 1 to 128 identifier characters), X-Ploeg-Acting-User (a person acting on the actor's behalf), X-Ploeg-Via (the channel, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters without leading or trailing space, such as mcp:Claude Code 2.1.296 or browser) and X-Ploeg-Confirmation (<confirmation id>:<lowercase SHA-256 hex of the text the person agreed to>). A repeated or malformed one answers 400 actor_required, invalid_acting_user, invalid_via or invalid_confirmation, and nothing changes; the last three need X-Ploeg-Actor. Every audit event such a request writes under the consumer's name carries detail.attribution (consumer, actor, actingUser, via, confirmation), the same shape on every route; existing detail keys are unchanged. A person's execution command (message, pause, resume, cancel, handback or take-control) is audited as operator.execution.commanded on the execution's Work Item. Events take actor=<identity> to keep only events whose attribution names it as actor or actingUser; events recorded before attribution existed never match. Findings and questions (ADR-0121): Work Item detail carries findings (every finding raised by id, with the writer's answer and unanswered), questions (every question its Runs asked, with waitingForPerson) and reviewDisagreements (review Rounds whose shadow reviewer's verdict differed from the acting readers'), and every Run shape carries findingItems, findingAnswers, questions and questionAnswers. A question to a person parks the Work Item at needs_human with Shift close reason question_for_person. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/questions/{questionId}/answer stores a person's answer to such a question: it requires execute permission and exactly one X-Ploeg-Actor, takes a questionAnswerRequest and answers questionAnswerResponse, 201 when new and 200 for a replayed commandId. It answers 400 invalid_request, command_required or invalid_answer, 404 for a Work Item outside the scope or a question to a person it does not have, 409 already_answered when the question has another answer and 409 command_conflict for a commandId reused with another body. Each answer is audited as question.answered. It accepts an answer in any Work Item state and queues nothing: every later Run of the Work Item is briefed with the question and its answer, so a person answers and then resumes a parked Work Item with a requeue that sets resume true. A requeue body with resume true resumes a Work Item parked on a question instead of restarting it: the new Shift reopens the Round that asked on the parked branch, with the parked Shift's earlier Rounds in its briefing and the parked Shift's unspent pool; Work Item detail resume says which Round, its cap (roundCapUsd), the pool and whether every question is answered. It is audited as work_item.requeued with detail resume true and resumes_round, and a replayed commandId returns the first result. Knowledge (ADR-0122): POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/knowledge-notes keeps a person's note on a Work Item in the consumer's scope in the Tenant's notes graph: it requires execute permission and exactly one X-Ploeg-Actor, attributes the note to X-Ploeg-Acting-User when given, else to the actor, takes a personNoteRequest and answers personNoteResponse, 201 when new and 200 for a replayed commandId. The note is trusted, read by later Runs of the Work Item's root, or of its repository at level repository, where the person's own words are their approval. It answers 404 outside the scope, 400 command_required or invalid_note, 409 command_conflict for a commandId reused with another note and 409 notes_off when the deployment keeps no notes. GET /api/v1/operator/knowledge/reviews?state=open|all&limit=1..200 answers noteReviewsResponse: the promotions and contradictions of Work Items in scope, newest first, open ones unless state=all. A promotion is a note suggested for a wider level; a merged pull request applies an open repository promotion on its own, and Client and Tenant promotions need a person. A contradiction is a note that disagreed with current notes on its subject; Runs see both marked contested until a person decides. POST /api/v1/operator/knowledge/reviews/{id}/decision takes a noteReviewDecisionRequest from a person (execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor) and answers noteReviewDecisionResponse: accept or reject a promotion (reject needs a reason and is kept, so the suggestion is not raised again), or keep_newer, keep_older or keep_both for a contradiction, where every note not kept gets a retraction that takes it out of every briefing. It answers 404 outside the scope, 409 review_decided and 422 invalid_decision. Each decision is audited as note.review_decided.

number.description: The pull request's number. Null when the link names none.

mergeState.description: Whether the pull request merges into its base branch, as the review poll last confirmed it (ADR-0040). conflicted needs two polls in a row at one head that report a conflict; a new head resets it to unknown. unknown until a forge that reports mergeability is polled, and on a forge that does not. It never changes the Work Item's state.

baseBranch.description: The branch the forge said the pull request targets, or the Work Item's target branch when the forge has not said. Null when neither is known.

checkedAt.description: When the review poll last read the merge state. Null until it has; a failed forge read leaves it unchanged.

agentVerdict.description: The verdict of the latest finished reading Run of the Work Item's latest Shift, empty when it gave none. A shadow Run's verdict is never this one (ADR-0096).

changesRequestedBy.description: Each distinct forge login that asked for changes on the pull request, ordered by its newest request first. Empty when nobody did.

mergedAt.description: When the forge merged the pull request (ADR-0045). Absent until a webhook or the review poll reports the merge.

mergedBy.description: The forge login that merged the pull request. Absent when unknown.

headSha.description: The newest head commit the forge reported for the pull request. Absent when unknown.

mergeCommitSha.description: The commit the merge produced on the base branch. Absent when unknown or not merged.

reviews.description: Every review the forge reported on the pull request, oldest first, at most the newest 50. Empty when none was recorded.

state.description: Absent when the forge did not classify the review.

headSha.description: The head commit the review was given on. Absent when the forge did not say.

harness.description: The Harness and agent profile the chart configures for this Role (PLOEG_TEAM_HARNESSES, rendered from the same values as the Role's worker; ADR-0097, proposed). Null when ploegd was not given the Role's Harness. A running pod may still run an older Harness after a change; observedHarness says what a Run recorded. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

model.description: The Role's default model: its (team, Role) managed inference policy's defaultModel, or the policy's single model (ADR-0091, ADR-0097, ADR-0103). Null without a policy, or when the policy lists more than one model and names no default. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

observedHarness.description: Observed, not configured: the Harness version most recently recorded on a Run of this team and Role, with the time it was recorded and the harness, profile and agent of that Run, so a consumer can tell when it belongs to another Harness than the configured one (ADR-0097, proposed). Null when no Run of the Role recorded a version. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

harnesses.description: The Harnesses an admission may choose for this Role (ADR-0098): its allowlist, with the default, each entry's qualification and the newest version a Run of the Role recorded with it. A Role without an allowlist lists its configured Harness alone. Null when ploegd was not given the Role's Harness. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

pendingByHarness.description: The Role's pending Runs per stored Harness key (ADR-0099). An entry with allowed false is a Run no workload claims, because the allowlist no longer contains its Harness; ploegd alerts on it and leaves the Run as it is. Empty when no pending Run stores a Harness. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

models.description: The models the Role's managed inference policy lists, which an admission may choose from (ADR-0103). Null without a policy. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

defaultModel.description: The model a Run of the Role calls when its admission chose none (ADR-0103); the same value as model. Null without a policy. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

pinnedScopes.description: Tracker container ids (Vikunja project, ClickUp list) pinned to this team: their items run as this team whoever is assigned, and unassigning withdraws this team's item. Sorted; empty when none. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

assignees.description: Tracker usernames, lowercased and sorted, whose assignment routes a Tracker Item to this team (config teams.<team>.assignees and PLOEG_TEAM_MAP). Empty when no username routes to the team. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

heldUsd.description: The Hold: budget the Shift's unsettled Runs still hold against its pool (ADR-0012, ADR-0093). Always present since ADR-0093; an older Ploeg sends only reservedUsd.

reservedUsd.description: Deprecated alias of heldUsd, always equal to it (ADR-0093). It is removed from v1 once the deprecation window closes; read heldUsd.

state.description: The Work Item's lifecycle position. active means a Team is working it (ADR-0093). leased is the retired name of active: Ploeg no longer emits it since ADR-0093 and keeps it in this enum only so a consumer's validation of older payloads holds; the state filter still accepts it as active until the deprecated forms are removed.

waitingFor.description: The tracker items this Work Item waits for that are not done, as its tracker last reported them (ADR-0123). While it lists any, a queued Work Item gets no Shift; the hold ends when the tracker marks each one done. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

premiseCheck.description: The Work Item's premise check before its first writer (ADR-0123); null when its Team runs none or it has not run yet. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

usage.description: A Run's usage as its harness reported it, with the cost Ploeg observed. Every field is absent when unknown; the fields after costUsd are kept since ADR-0045.

problem.description: A writing Run's account of what was wrong or missing (ADR-0042), markdown, at most 4096 characters. Empty for a reading Run and for a writer that reported none.

solution.description: A writing Run's account of what it changed (ADR-0042), markdown, at most 4096 characters. Empty for a reading Run and for a writer that reported none.

costStatus.description: The Run's Cost Status. With a gateway account it follows the account: observed until the account settles, provisional inside the correction window, settled after. Without one it is observed while the Run runs with a reported cost and settled once it finished. unknown when there is no figure, including a settlement whose spend logs had no entries. Before ADR-0093 this field was only observed or unknown, and observed also covered provisional and settled costs.

settledAt.description: When the Run's gateway account was first settled. Absent before settlement and for a Run without an account.

costFinalAt.description: When the settled cost stops being corrected for late gateway charges: the end of the correction window, or settledAt when the settlement opened none.

costFinal.description: True once the Run's cost will no longer change. A settled cost before costFinalAt is provisional and may rise.

configuredModel.description: The model the Run's Role was configured with when ploegd claimed or admitted it: the single model of its (team, Role) managed inference policy (ADR-0091). Null when unknown: a Run recorded before ploegd kept it, a policy naming more than one model, or no policy.

harness.description: The harness the worker reported in its claim, such as openhands, acp, exec, claude-code or claude-environment (ADR-0091). Null when unknown: an Ask or operator execution, which ploeg-worker does not run, an older worker, or a Run recorded before ploegd kept it.

harnessProfile.description: The harness's adapter profile the worker reported, such as opencode or custom for the acp harness (ADR-0091). Null when the harness has no profile or it is unknown.

planHash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the Team plan ploegd held when it claimed the Run (ADR-0091). Two Runs with the same hash ran under the same plan shape. Null for a plan-less team, an Ask, an operator execution, or a Run recorded before ploegd kept it.

ploegdVersion.description: The version of the ploegd that claimed or admitted the Run (ADR-0091). Null when unknown.

harnessVersion.description: The Harness version the worker read from its Harness binary's --version at startup and sent with its claim or Outcome Report (ADR-0097, proposed), as text, written once. For claude-environment it is the dispatching CLI's version, not the remote session's (ADR-0084). Null when unknown: the worker skipped or failed the probe (exec, a custom acp profile, a binary it could not resolve before the clone), an older worker, an Ask or operator execution, or a Run recorded before ploegd kept it.

harnessAgent.description: The agent's own name and version as the worker reported them in the Outcome Report, such as an ACP agent's agentInfo from initialize (ADR-0097, proposed), written once. Null when the agent did not identify itself, the Run did not report, or it is unknown.

modelMismatch.description: True when a gateway model group (alias) other than configuredModel served one of the Run's calls, such as a fallback group; false when every call was served by configuredModel (ADR-0091). Provider model names in usage are not compared, since the gateway records them instead of the alias. Null while either side is unknown: no configured model, or no served model groups recorded at settlement, as for a Run settled before Ploeg recorded them.

shadow.description: True for a Run of a shadow Role (ADR-0096): a reading Run beside the Round's reviewer whose verdict and findings are recorded here and never act. Its verdict opens no fix Round, sets no close reason and is not the pull request's agentVerdict; its findings are not posted and brief no later Run; its cost counts in the Shift like any Run. Absent from a ploegd older than ADR-0096; false for every other Run.

limits.description: The limits that stop the Run's prompt, as its worker reported them when the prompt started (ADR-0114, proposed), written once. Absent, never null or zero, when unknown: the prompt has not started, the worker is older than ADR-0114, the Run is an Ask or an operator execution, or it was recorded before ploegd kept limits.

findingItems.description: A reading Run's findings by id as ploegd stored them, with the ids it assigned (ADR-0121); empty for a writer and for a Run that reported none.

findingAnswers.description: A writing Run's answers to the findings it was briefed with (ADR-0121); empty otherwise.

questions.description: The questions the Run asked, with the ids ploegd assigned (ADR-0121); empty for a shadow and for a Run that asked none.

questionAnswers.description: The Run's answers to questions to a reviewer or the next Run (ADR-0121).

executionBrief.description: One operator execution bound to the Work Item. owner is the person id the execution was admitted for (its X-Ploeg-Actor). The execution's owner may read and steer it through GET and POST /api/v1/operator/executions/{id} from any execute-capable Operator Consumer whose Teams include team (ADR-0108).

requestId.description: The consumer's requestId, on operator.work_item.admitted only.

attribution.description: Who made an operator change and how (ADR-0108), on every audit event an operator mutation wrote. consumer is the Operator Consumer whose bearer credential made the request; actor is its X-Ploeg-Actor; actingUser its X-Ploeg-Acting-User, the person acting on actor's behalf; via its X-Ploeg-Via channel label, such as mcp:<client> <version> or browser; confirmation its X-Ploeg-Confirmation, <confirmation id>:<SHA-256 hex of the text the person agreed to>. Events recorded before attribution existed omit it.

findings.description: Every finding raised by id on the Work Item with its answer (ADR-0121), in the order first raised. Absent from an older ploegd.

questions.description: Every question the Work Item's Runs asked, oldest first, with its answer (ADR-0121). Absent from an older ploegd.

reviewDisagreements.description: The review Rounds where a shadow reviewer's verdict differed from the acting readers' (ADR-0096, ADR-0121), oldest first. Absent from an older ploegd.

resume.description: Set when the Work Item's last Shift stopped on a question to a person and the Team's plan can reopen its Round; null otherwise. Absent from an older ploegd.

withdrawn.description: True when this request withdrew the item; false when nothing was live.

shiftId.description: The Shift this request closed with close reason withdrawn_by_operator.

cancelledRuns.description: Pending Runs that will not start.

stoppedRuns.description: Running Runs finished; each worker stops when its next renew is refused.

keysBlocked.description: False when a model key block is unconfirmed; the controller's block sweep retries it.

commandId.description: The cancelRequest commandId, null for a cancel without a body.

replayed.description: True when commandId already withdrew this item and nothing changed.

approved.description: True when approval queued the Work Item; false when rejection closed it as done (ADR-0031).

fromRound.description: The planned Round the new Shift starts at, counted from 1. Default 1.

poolUsd.description: The new Shift's pool. Default the Team plan's pool; at most the consumer's maxBudgetUsd.

note.description: Operator text added to every Run's briefing in the new Shift.

commandId.description: Idempotency key. A replay returns the first result.

expectedState.description: The state the caller saw. A mismatch answers 409 state_changed.

resume.description: True resumes a Work Item whose last Shift stopped on a question to a person (ADR-0121): the new Shift reopens the plan Round that asked (the detail's resume.fromRound) on the parked Shift's branch, keeps the earlier Rounds' work, findings and answers in its briefing, and gets the parked Shift's unspent pool, at least that Round's cap, unless poolUsd is given. It cannot be combined with fromRound (400). 409 nothing_to_resume when the last Shift did not stop on such a question, 409 question_unanswered while one of its questions has no answer. Absent or false is the full restart.

poolUsd.description: The pool authorized for the new Shift; 0 is unmetered.

shiftId.description: The Shift the requeue opened; null for a Team without Shifts.

previousShiftId.description: The item's most recent closed Shift, which stays closed with its close reason.

replayed.description: True when commandId repeated an earlier requeue and nothing changed.

resume.description: True when the requeue resumed a Shift parked on a question to a person.

cancelRequest.description: Optional body of POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/cancel. Without a body the cancel is unguarded, as before.

commandId.description: Idempotency key. A cancel whose commandId already withdrew the item answers replayed true and changes nothing.

expectedShiftId.description: The Shift the caller saw. When the item's open Shift differs, or none is open, the cancel answers 409 shift_changed and withdraws nothing.

commandId.description: Idempotency key, unique per consumer. A replay returns the first note; the same commandId with another body answers 409 command_conflict.

text.description: The instruction, trimmed. The next claimed Run of the Work Item is briefed with it.

expectedShiftId.description: The Shift the caller saw. When the item's open Shift differs, or none is open, the note answers 409 shift_changed and is not stored.

shiftId.description: The Shift open when the note was stored; null when none was.

consumed.description: True once a claimed Run's briefing carried the note.

replayed.description: True when commandId repeated an earlier note and nothing changed.

workItemAdmissionRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/operator/work-items (ADR-0102). Unknown fields are refused.

requestId.description: Idempotency key, unique per consumer. Every other field and the actor form the request's fingerprint.

team.description: The Team whose queue receives the Work Item; it must be in the consumer's scope and have a plan or uniform dispatch.

target.description: The key of a registered, ready Work Target. Repository URLs and credentials are never accepted.

description.description: What the Work Item asks for; the Runs are briefed with it.

budgetUsd.description: The Work Item's allotment, at most the consumer's maxBudgetUsd. Default maxBudgetUsd. The Shift pool is the lower of the Team plan's pool and the allotment.

harness.description: The Harness every Run of the Work Item should use, by its key in the Teams read: acp/<profile>, or acp for acp/opencode, or the Harness name (ADR-0098). It must be admissible for at least one Role of the Team's plan: in its allowlist, and qualified, its default or allowed by allowUnqualifiedHarnesses. Each Role that admits it uses it, the others their default. Absent = each Role's default. Part of the fingerprint.

model.description: The model alias every Run of the Work Item should call (ADR-0103). At least one Role's managed inference policy must list it; each Role that lists it calls it, the others their default model. Absent = each Role's default model. Part of the fingerprint.

workItemAdmissionResponse.description: 201 for a new Admission, 200 for a replay.

shiftId.description: The Work Item's most recent Shift; null before one opened, which the sweeper repairs.

budgetUsd.description: The allotment stored on the Work Item.

poolUsd.description: The pool of the most recent Shift; null before one opened.

replayed.description: True when requestId repeated an earlier Admission and nothing changed.

roles.description: Each Role of the Team's plan with the Harness key and model its Runs store, resolved from the request as the Shift resolves them (ADR-0098, ADR-0103). Null when ploegd stores none for that Role. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

active.description: Work Items a Team is working (ADR-0093). Always present since ADR-0093; an older Ploeg sends only leased.

leased.description: Deprecated alias of active, always equal to it (ADR-0093). It is removed from v1 once the deprecation window closes; read active.

heldUsd.description: The Holds of live or unresolved Runs, current rather than windowed (ADR-0093). Always present since ADR-0093; an older Ploeg sends only reservedUsd.

reservedUsd.description: Deprecated alias of heldUsd, always equal to it (ADR-0093). It is removed from v1 once the deprecation window closes; read heldUsd.

models.description: The provider model names the gateway's spend logs recorded, such as fireworks_ai/accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4p1-flash.

modelGroups.description: The gateway model groups (aliases) that served the Run's calls, a fallback group included, from the spend logs' model_group (ADR-0091). Empty when unknown, as for a Run settled before Ploeg recorded them.

settledAt.description: When the Run's gateway account was first settled. Absent before settlement and for a Run without an account.

costFinalAt.description: When the settled cost stops being corrected for late gateway charges: the end of the correction window, or settledAt when the settlement opened none.

costFinal.description: True once the Run's cost will no longer change. A settled cost before costFinalAt is provisional and may rise.

configuredModel.description: The model the Run's Role was configured with when ploegd claimed or admitted it: the single model of its (team, Role) managed inference policy (ADR-0091). Null when unknown: a Run recorded before ploegd kept it, a policy naming more than one model, or no policy.

harness.description: The harness the worker reported in its claim, such as openhands, acp, exec, claude-code or claude-environment (ADR-0091). Null when unknown: an Ask or operator execution, which ploeg-worker does not run, an older worker, or a Run recorded before ploegd kept it.

harnessProfile.description: The harness's adapter profile the worker reported, such as opencode or custom for the acp harness (ADR-0091). Null when the harness has no profile or it is unknown.

planHash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the Team plan ploegd held when it claimed the Run (ADR-0091). Two Runs with the same hash ran under the same plan shape. Null for a plan-less team, an Ask, an operator execution, or a Run recorded before ploegd kept it.

ploegdVersion.description: The version of the ploegd that claimed or admitted the Run (ADR-0091). Null when unknown.

harnessVersion.description: The Harness version the worker read from its Harness binary's --version at startup and sent with its claim or Outcome Report (ADR-0097, proposed), as text, written once. For claude-environment it is the dispatching CLI's version, not the remote session's (ADR-0084). Null when unknown: the worker skipped or failed the probe (exec, a custom acp profile, a binary it could not resolve before the clone), an older worker, an Ask or operator execution, or a Run recorded before ploegd kept it.

harnessAgent.description: The agent's own name and version as the worker reported them in the Outcome Report, such as an ACP agent's agentInfo from initialize (ADR-0097, proposed), written once. Null when the agent did not identify itself, the Run did not report, or it is unknown.

modelMismatch.description: True when a gateway model group (alias) other than configuredModel served one of the Run's calls, such as a fallback group; false when every call was served by configuredModel (ADR-0091). Provider model names in usage are not compared, since the gateway records them instead of the alias. Null while either side is unknown: no configured model, or no served model groups recorded at settlement, as for a Run settled before Ploeg recorded them.

shadow.description: True for a Run of a shadow Role (ADR-0096): a reading Run beside the Round's reviewer whose verdict and findings are recorded here and never act. Its verdict opens no fix Round, sets no close reason and is not the pull request's agentVerdict; its findings are not posted and brief no later Run; its cost counts in the Shift like any Run. Absent from a ploegd older than ADR-0096; false for every other Run.

limits.description: The limits that stop the Run's prompt, as its worker reported them when the prompt started (ADR-0114, proposed), written once. Absent, never null or zero, when unknown: the prompt has not started, the worker is older than ADR-0114, the Run is an Ask or an operator execution, or it was recorded before ploegd kept limits.

factsEpic.description: One tracker parent (epic or parent task) of the Work Item, as Ploeg last read it from work_item_epics. firstSeenAt is when Ploeg first saw the relation; removedAt is set when the tracker stopped reporting it, and a relation reported again starts over with a new firstSeenAt.

factsWithdrawal.description: One withdrawal of the Work Item recorded in the audit log.

actor.description: The audit actor as recorded: operator:<consumer>:<person> for an operator withdrawal, otherwise the tracker actor.

externalRef.description: The tracker reference used in commit trailers, or empty for manual work.

url.description: The tracker page, or empty when neither the tracker nor its link template gives one.

state.description: The Work Item's lifecycle position. active means a Team is working it (ADR-0093). leased is the retired name of active: Ploeg no longer emits it since ADR-0093 and keeps it in this enum only so a consumer's validation of older payloads holds; the state filter still accepts it as active until the deprecated forms are removed.

createdAt.description: When Ploeg first stored the Work Item.

trackerCreatedAt.description: When the tracker says the ticket was created; null until Ploeg read it.

estimateSeconds.description: The tracker's time estimate; null when the tracker keeps none or none was set.

externalScope.description: The tracker board or project the Work Item came from, as Ploeg stored it (work_items.external_scope); empty when the tracker gave none. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

admittedAt.description: When the Work Item was first queued or approved: the time of its first work_item.queued or work_item.approved audit entry. Null when it never was. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

factsLiveUsage.description: What the gateway recorded so far for one running Run, read when the facts were read (ADR-0049). A running Run without an entry could not be read.

factsPullRequestRef.description: One recorded pull request: Ploeg's id, the forge dialect, the repository and the number.

factsCommitStatus.description: The combined commit status Ploeg last read at headSha.

factsCIJob.description: One job of a CI run. startedAt, completedAt and queuedSeconds are absent when the forge did not report them.

factsCIRun.description: One CI run of the pull request (an Actions run, a pipeline or the statuses of one commit), replaced whole by each forge read. Job logs are never kept.

factsPullRequestEvent.description: Who did what on the pull request's conversation and when. No comment or review text is kept.

factsIndentation.description: The raw indentation measurements of one changed file, taken from the unified diff when the pull request merged. The diff itself is never stored.

unit.description: The spaces one indent level counts as in this file's diff; a tab is one level.

added.description: The sum of the indent levels of the non-blank added lines.

removed.description: The sum of the indent levels of the non-blank removed lines.

maxDepth.description: The deepest indent level of an added line.

factsFile.description: One file the merged pull request changed. A null line count is one the forge did not report; indentation is null when the diff was not measured.

factsChangedPaths.description: The paths the pull request changes at headSha, as the forge listed them while open. truncated is true when it changed more than Ploeg keeps.

factsRevert.description: A merged pull request that reverted this one. It need not be one of Ploeg's. matchedBy is title when its title began with Revert and named this number, and commit when one of its commits said it reverts this pull request's merge or head commit.

factsDeployment.description: The first reported deploy of one environment that carried the pull request's merge commit (ADR-0047).

factsPullRequest.description: One pull request opened for the Work Item, with every fact the forge reported and Ploeg stored. A null is a fact the forge has not reported, never a zero. Reviews, events, CI runs and deployments are oldest first.

url.description: The pull request link a Run or checkpoint reported, or empty when none named it.

firstSeenAt.description: When Ploeg first recorded the pull request.

labels.description: The label names the forge reported at merge; null when not read.

commits.description: Commits counted by the last activity read; a lower bound when activityTruncated.

forcePushes.description: Null on a forge that does not report force pushes.

factsStatusTransition.description: One move of the Work Item into another tracker status or bucket, in the order Ploeg recorded it.

gate.description: The delivery gate the status mapped to when Ploeg recorded the move, or null.

observed.description: True when the tracker did not say when the move happened, or said a time before the previous move, so at is when Ploeg received it.

factsGateTransition.description: One move of the Work Item into another delivery gate (ADR-0051), in the order Ploeg recorded it.

actor.description: The tracker user who made the move, or null when the tracker did not say.

reason.description: The bounce reason Ploeg found on the ticket when it recorded a move back to an earlier gate.

factsCheckpoint.description: A checkpoint a Run recorded with a pull request URL, oldest first (ADR-0079). Its createdAt can be earlier than the forge's opened time of that pull request.

factsRunBudgetHold.description: The budget one Run still holds, as Ploeg's budget accounting counts it (run_budget_holds): the authorized amount of a running Run without a gateway account, the larger of authorized and observed spend while its account is unsettled, and observed spend above the reconciled spend once reconciled. Listed only while above zero, including Runs outside a Shift.

heldUsd.description: The budget this Run still holds (ADR-0093). Always present since ADR-0093; an older Ploeg sends only reservedUsd.

reservedUsd.description: Deprecated alias of heldUsd, always equal to it (ADR-0093). It is removed from v1 once the deprecation window closes; read heldUsd.

factsDeployEnvironment.description: An environment the repository of one of the Work Item's pull requests has reported any deploy of, with its earliest reported deploy.

factsRosterEntry.description: A login the stored facts name, with what it did: merger merged a pull request, reviewer reviewed one, author opened one, pusher pushed or force-pushed, commenter commented on its conversation or diff, and mover moved the ticket between delivery gates. Ploeg's own forge logins are included; botLogins names them.

workItemFacts.description: The delivery facts of one Work Item (ADR-0079): what Ploeg stored about its Runs, pull requests, forge and tracker, with no derived figure. Runs and shifts use the same shapes as the Work Item detail; runs oldest first.

activityAt.description: The latest timestamp among the facts below, falling back to the Work Item's creation; the facts list orders by it.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints that recorded a pull request URL, oldest first. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

runBudgetHolds.description: The Runs that still hold budget, by Run id. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

botLogins.description: The forge logins Ploeg itself acts as, lowercased.

checkpoints.description: Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

asks.description: Optional: absent from a Ploeg older than ADR-0082.

image.description: An SVG Ploeg uploads as an attachment of the comment and shows above the markdown. Ploeg refuses one with scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, external references or entity declarations (422 unsafe_svg). On a forge that takes no attachment the comment carries the markdown alone.

number.description: The number of one of the Work Item's pull requests. Omitted = the newest one.

adoptCommentId.description: An existing comment on that pull request that carries a Ploeg marker, to take over instead of posting a new one.

commentId.description: The forge's comment id, null when the forge did not list the comment again after posting it.

imageUrl.description: The attachment URL the comment embeds: absolute on Forgejo, project-relative on GitLab. Null without an image or when the forge refused it.

allowance.description: A scope's Ask Allowance for one period (ADR-0082). settledUsd is the reconciled spend of the period's Asks, heldUsd what their unsettled accounts still hold, remainingUsd the limit less both and never below zero. resetAt ends the period. askBudgetUsd is the per-Ask Budget an admission needs; asksEnabled is false when the team has no (team, ask) inference policy.

scopeKind.description: team in phase 1; a later scope is a new value.

askAdmitRequest.description: POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/asks body. askId is the consumer's idempotency key; Ploeg keeps only the question's SHA-256. The per-Ask Budget is server policy, not a field.

costStatus.description: observed while the Ask's account is unsettled, provisional while its settlement is inside the correction window, settled after, and unknown before any spend was observed or when settlement found no spend-log entries. Before ADR-0093 an unsettled Ask read provisional.

usd.description: Settled spend, or the highest spend observed so far; null before any observation.

ask.description: A read-only Run about a Work Item with no Shift, Round or Lease (ADR-0082). state is open while its Run runs before its deadline, finished once the consumer finished it, and expired when its deadline passed first.

askCredential.description: The LiteLLM key for one Ask, capped at budgetUsd and scoped to models until expiresAt. It is returned once; Ploeg never stores it.

askAdmitResponse.description: 201 for a new Ask, 200 for a replayed askId. credential is null on a replay once a mint may have begun: finish that Ask and ask again under a new askId.

allowanceRefusalResponse.description: 402 allowance_exhausted: the allowance cannot cover the per-Ask Budget until allowance.resetAt.

factsAsk.description: One Ask about the Work Item (ADR-0082). An Ask is not delivery: runs, liveUsage, runBudgetHolds and activityAt leave its Run out, so a consumer reports Ask spend apart from what building the Work Item cost. usd is the settled spend once costStatus is settled, otherwise the highest spend observed so far or null; a settlement inside its correction window stays provisional.

transcriptEntry.description: One entry of a Run's transcript (ADR-0090). Fields a kind does not use are absent.

seq.description: Position in the Run's transcript, assigned by the worker. Consecutive unless entries were dropped on the way.

at.description: When the worker observed the entry.

text.description: message and thought: the agent's text, coalesced from its chunks. tool_output: what the tool returned, an edit as removed (-) and added (+) lines. stage: what the worker or adapter did. truncated: why recording stopped. Redacted; at most 4 KiB.

toolCallId.description: tool_call and tool_output: the call this entry belongs to.

status.description: tool_call: the call's status when this entry was recorded. A call has one entry per status it reached.

input.description: tool_call: the command, path, query or URL the call was given, else its input as compact JSON.

clipped.description: text or input was cut at its limit.

transcriptResponse.description: GET /api/v1/operator/runs/{id}/transcript?after=&limit=: the Run's transcript entries with seq greater than after (default 0), at most limit (1 to 500, default 200), in seq order. A Run outside the consumer's teams answers 404. Poll with after=nextAfter until complete is true and hasMore is false. An older Ploeg answers 404.

nextAfter.description: The seq of the last entry on this page, or after when the page is empty.

hasMore.description: Entries after this page exist now.

truncated.description: The transcript reached its limit (5,000 entries or 2 MiB) and ends in a truncated entry.

complete.description: The Run has ended, so no entry will be added.

costStatus.description: Cost Status, the one value set for every cost Ploeg reports (ADR-0093). observed: spend seen so far that can still move, because the Run or Ask is live or its account has not settled. provisional: settled once and still inside the correction window, so a late gateway charge may raise it. settled: final. unknown: Ploeg has no trustworthy figure, which is never zero. A place that cannot reach a value says which subset it uses.

runLimits.description: What stops a Run's prompt (ADR-0114, proposed): promptSeconds counts from promptStartedAt, idleSeconds from the agent's last activity. An absent limit is no limit. A consumer can show how close a Run is to a stop: the prompt stops at promptStartedAt + promptSeconds, and after idleSeconds without agent activity.

promptSeconds.description: The most the prompt may run: for acp the earlier of the profile's prompt timeout (PLOEG_ACP_PROMPT_TIMEOUT, default 45m) and what is left of the worker's harness timeout (PLOEG_HARNESS_TIMEOUT, default 100m); for every other Harness what is left of the harness timeout when the prompt started.

idleSeconds.description: How long the agent may show no activity before a watchdog stops the Run: for acp the profile's idle timeout over protocol activity (PLOEG_ACP_IDLE_TIMEOUT, default 10m, checked every half of it); for openhands, claude-code and exec the worker's idle watchdog over output and model traffic (PLOEG_HARNESS_IDLE_TIMEOUT, default 15m). Absent for claude-environment, whose session no idle watchdog watches.

promptStartedAt.description: When the worker started the prompt: the acp session/prompt request, the claude-environment session dispatch, or the spawn of every other Harness, to the second.

key.description: What an admission names to choose this Harness: acp/<profile> for acp, the Harness name otherwise.

qualification.description: Whether the Harness is qualified. An unqualified Harness other than the Role's default is admitted only when the Team set allowUnqualifiedHarnesses. Null when ploegd was not told.

default.description: True for the Role's default Harness, which a Run without a chosen Harness uses and which is always admissible.

observedVersion.description: The newest version a Run of this Role recorded with this Harness; null when none did.

allowed.description: Whether the Role's current allowlist contains the Harness.

name.description: the harness of the Run that recorded the version

profile.description: the agent profile of the Run that recorded the version

workItemFinding.description: One finding raised by id on the Work Item (ADR-0121), as of its last raise.

role.description: the reading Role that first raised it

round.description: the Round it was first raised in

lastRaisedRound.description: the Round it was last raised in, in the Shift shiftId names

shadow.description: raised by a shadow reviewer (ADR-0096): recorded for comparison, never briefed or answered

answer.description: the writer's answer after the last raise; null while none

unanswered.description: true when a writing Run of the same Shift finished after the last raise without answering it

workItemQuestion.description: One question a Run of the Work Item asked (ADR-0121).

answeredBy.description: person, or the Role of the Run that answered; null while unanswered

waitingForPerson.description: true for a question to a person nobody answered: answer it with POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/questions/{questionId}/answer

reviewDisagreement.description: A review Round whose shadow reviewer (ADR-0096) gave another verdict than the Round's acting readers combined the way the review loop combines them: request_changes when any asked for changes, else approve when one approved, else none.

commandId.description: Idempotency key, unique per consumer. A replay returns the first answer; the same commandId with another body answers 409 command_conflict.

answer.description: The person's answer, trimmed. Every later Run of the Work Item is briefed with it next to the question.

replayed.description: True when commandId repeated an earlier answer and nothing changed.

resumeOffer.description: What POST .../requeue with resume true would do (ADR-0121).

askedRound.description: the parked Shift's Round whose Run asked

fromRound.description: the plan Round the resume reopens; a fix Round maps to the plan's writing or last review Round

roundCapUsd.description: the most the reopened Round's Runs can be authorized: the sum of its Roles' caps, shadows included

poolUsd.description: the resumed Shift's pool, the most it may spend in all, including the Rounds after the reopened one: the parked Shift's unspent pool, at least roundCapUsd

ready.description: true when every question of the parked Round has an answer, so a resume is accepted

waitingQuestionIds.description: the questions of the parked Round still without an answer

dependency.description: One open tracker dependency of a Work Item (ADR-0123).

kind.description: blocked_by: the tracker says this Work Item is blocked by it. follows: the tracker says this Work Item follows it.

workItemId.description: Ploeg's Work Item for the same tracker item, or null when Ploeg has none.

checkedAt.description: When Ploeg last read the tracker's dependencies of this Work Item.

premiseCheck.description: A Work Item's premise check (ADR-0123): one classifier call on a gateway model priced at zero, before the first writer. proceed opens the Shift; ask and too_big move the Work Item to needs_human with the question and spend nothing on a writer; skipped means the check gave up and dispatch went on. A person assigning or requeuing the Work Item again sends it on without a second check.

verdict.description: Null while every attempt so far failed without an answer.

question.description: What a person must answer (ask) or a suggested split (too_big); empty otherwise. Model output about tracker text; untrusted.

reason.description: One line on why, or the last failure for skipped. Untrusted.

supersedes.description: The key of a current note this one replaces.

conflictsWith.description: For a contradiction: the current notes the note disagreed with.

applied.description: An accepted promotion's note or concept is written; an accepted Client or Tenant promotion waits for the review actor.

title.description: The note's title; an untrusted title is reduced to one escaped line.
